name: Yakushi-Ike Park Shikisai no Mori

en.name: Yakushi-Ike Park Shikisai no Mori
en.description: Selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Historic Parks, featuring a scenic central pond, historic thatched farmhouses, and seasonal plum and iris gardens. It offers quiet walking trails and a craft brewery café in Machida.
en.notes: Best visited during clear weather for relaxing walking tours and seasonal foliage photos.
en.reservation: Open access; no entrance reservation required.
en.parking: Park parking lot available on site.

ja.name: 薬師池公園 四季彩の杜
ja.description: 日本の歴史公園100選に選ばれた町田市の公園で、大きな池を中心に茅葺きの旧永井家住宅や梅林、菖蒲田が広がります。四季の花々と直売所カフェが親しまれています。
